name: Rain-Soaked Crowd
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival
description: A crowd of carnival goers are spurred to panic by supernatural rain.
disable: DC 17 Diplomacy check (trained) to calm them down, DC 18 Intimidation check (trained) to cow them, DC 20 Athletics check (trained) to force them back

offensiveAbilities.name: Surge Forward
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs fail to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event

Effect The crowd surges forward, dealing 2d10+7 bludgeoning damage to each PC. Each affected creature must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their next skill check to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next skill check to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event.

Effect: Surge Forward
